focus.jnote: The scan boarded three names into the single biggest scheduled event of the month — that’s the story. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivers his first Jackson Hole keynote today; the keynote is Friday, August 28 at 10:00am ET, Warsh’s first as Fed Chair, with the symposium running August 27 to 29 in Jackson Hole, Wyoming. This morning equity futures are pointing to a mixed open — Dow futures advanced 0.07% and Russell 2000 rose 0.04%, while S&P 500 futures fell 0.12% and Nasdaq 100 futures dropped 0.30%. On the scanner’s boarded names: WEAT and DBA are agriculture-ETF breakouts, and Rubrik (RBRK) gapped down despite a strong print — Rubrik raised its fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS guidance to 47–53 cents versus the 31-cent estimate and its revenue outlook to $1.685–1.693 billion, yet the stock was down 9.73% to $97 in Thursday’s extended trading. Oil eased slightly — Brent crude fell 0.28% to $88.27 a barrel and WTI declined 0.47% to $83.14. The overriding gate: the Warsh keynote is today, not tomorrow.
focus.notdown: WEAT and DBA are the bullish names boarded — both tagged Grade A ATH breakouts in the grain complex. But there are real caveats: the scanner’s prices don’t match live quotes — it lists WEAT at $27.54 and DBA at $28.99, while live pre-market shows WEAT’s last pre-market price at 25.520 and DBA’s last pre-market price at 28.41. Both also carry an UNKNOWN next-earnings gate (an ETF artifact — no single-name print — but confirm), and DBA is a same-day breakout still proving itself. Do NOT add sector rows the scan didn’t board.
focus.notup: RBRK is the lone bearish single-name boarded — a Type A gap-down, tagged Grade B. The honest problem: it’s a double-beat with RAISED guidance that gapped DOWN, so the bearish tape read fights the fundamentals; the scanner itself flags relative volume at 0.04x (far below the 1.3x bar), thin open interest (170, below the 500 bar), and liquidity NOT verified. Selling bear calls into a name whose fundamentals are strongly bullish — and into a Warsh keynote — carries violent squeeze risk on any positive re-read. Confirm every gate before acting.
focus.why: Why RED? Two reasons. First, the calendar locks out GREEN on its own: Warsh’s first Jackson Hole keynote is TODAY at 10:00 AM ET, an FOMC-weight, unscheduled-in-content event just 19 days before the Sept 16 decision. Second, every boarded name carries an unresolved gate: WEAT and DBA show scanner prices that don’t match live quotes and UNKNOWN earnings flags, and RBRK is a bearish gap that contradicts its own double-beat-plus-raise on 0.04x volume with liquidity NOT verified. P(≥1% gap) at 40% sits above the 35% trigger. Stand down on new credit spreads, verify each gate, keep cash, and re-run tomorrow pre-open.

setups.read: RBRK boarded as a Type A · Grade B bearish post-earnings gap — but this is the board’s most conflicted name. Rubrik reported earnings of 22 cents per share, blowing past the 4-cent consensus, on revenue of $427.26 million versus a $396.278 million estimate, and raised its fiscal 2027 EPS guidance to 47–53 cents vs the 31-cent estimate and revenue to $1.685–1.693 billion — yet the stock dropped 9.3% after hours even as it beat revenue by $31 million, following a rally of about 85% over six months to an all-time peak of $107.91. So the bearish gap is a ‘sell-the-news’ on a double-beat-plus-raise, which fights the fundamentals. The scanner also flags relative volume 0.04x (far below the 1.3x bar), open interest 170 (below the 500 bar), and liquidity NOT verified. A weak, contradictory Grade-B setup.
